description: Everything about one Eased component as Markdown: title, description, tier, README docs (usage, props, motion signature), install command and dependencies. Free components also include the full source of their files and a demo showing real usage, so you can read or adapt the code. Pro components return docs and metadata only, unless this server was added with an Eased Pro token header, in which case their source comes too.

slug.description: The component slug, e.g. "button" or "hover-card", as returned by list_components or search_components.

name: get_component
title: Get an Eased component
